Name: SKU_MINERS
Notes: Cheapest body on the field. Can dig a tunnel entrance.

Name: SKU_WARRIORS
Notes: The default Skulkin block. Elemental-coloured armour.

Name: SKU_WATCHMEN
Notes: Anti-large. Holds a line against dragons and giants.

Name: SKU_PITBOSSES
Notes: Overseers. Nearby Skulkin reassemble twice instead of once.

Name: SKU_SKULLTRUCK
Notes: Chariot. Massive charge, terrible turning circle.

Name: SKU_TREADASSAULT
Notes: Grinds through infantry. Useless against armour.

Name: SER_HYP_SOLDIERS
Notes: Blue. Chance to briefly stun on hit.

Name: SER_FAN_SOLDIERS
Notes: Red. Killed enemy models have a 25% chance to raise as Fangpyre.

Name: SER_CON_WARRIORS
Notes: Black/orange. Can BURROW: deploy anywhere, ambush.

Name: SER_CON_SOLDIERS
Notes: Crushing grip: roots the unit it engages.

Name: SER_VEN_SPITTERS
Notes: Green. Hits cause hallucination: target attacks randomly for 5s.

Name: SER_ANA_WARRIORS
Notes: Purple. Bigger, smarter, natural leaders. Expensive.

Name: SER_DEVOURER
Notes: Campaign boss. Grows every time it eats a unit.

Name: STO_SCOUTS
Notes: Yellow markings, flaming bolts. No shoulder armour.

Name: STO_SOLDIERS
Notes: Conical red hat. The block that holds the line.

Name: STO_SWORDSMEN
Notes: Same body, no shield, more attack.

Name: STO_GIANT
Notes: Single colossus. Cannot be killed by normal damage — only knocked down.

Name: NIN_POLICE
Notes: Cheap allied line. Arrives as reinforcements.

Name: NIN_SHINTARO
Notes: Sky Folk. Can be deployed on high ground only.

Name: NDR_DRONES
Notes: Expendable. Self-destruct on death for small AoE.

Name: NDR_SENTRIES
Notes: Guards. Can be hacked and turned by Zane.

Name: CUL_CULTISTS
Notes: Bone armour over red robes. Upgrades via The Curse.

Name: GHO_NINJA
Notes: Attila, Hackler, Ming, Spyder, Howla, Yokai, Wooo.

Name: GHO_WARRIORS
Notes: Cowler, Cyrus, Ghurka, Pitch, Pyrrhus, Wail.

Name: GHO_SKREEMERS
Notes: Every 15s a surviving Skreemer spawns another Skreemer.

Name: GHO_PREEMINENT
Notes: Kaiju. One per campaign. Dies to a single large body of water.

Name: VER_SWARM
Notes: What's left when armour breaks. Kill these to stop Reform.

Name: SOG_BIKERS
Notes: Luke, Chopper Maroon, Mohawk, Nails, Skip Vicious.

Name: DRH_FIRSTBOURNE
Notes: Mother of dragons. Neutral until captured — by either side.

Name: PYR_WHIPPERS
Notes: Long reach, pulls enemies out of formation.

Name: CRY_VENGE_WAR
Notes: Aura: enemy heroes within 800cm cannot use abilities.

Name: CRY_ZOMBIES
Notes: Converted civilians. Free — spawn from enemy casualties.

Name: IMP_EMPRESSMECH
Notes: Beatrix's ultimate. Immune to elemental damage.

Name: LRD_SAMUKAI
Notes: Four arms, four bone daggers. King of the Underworld.

Name: LRD_GARMADON_U
Notes: Four-armed. Commands the Skulkin from the throne.

Name: HRO_KRUNCHA
Notes: General of Earth. Helmeted, permanently furious.

Name: HRO_NUCKAL
Notes: General of Lightning. Spiked skull, no impulse control.

Name: HRO_WYPLASH
Notes: General of Ice. Straw hat, deeply paranoid.

Name: LRD_PYTHOR
Notes: Last Anacondrai. Snake King. Turns invisible.

Name: HRO_SLITHRAA
Notes: Deposed Hypnobrai General. Wants his tail back.

Name: HRO_ACIDICUS
Notes: Venomari General. Invented the venom vials.

Name: LRD_OVERLORD
Notes: Creator of the Stone Army. The first evil.

Name: LRD_KOZU
Notes: Four arms, twin butterfly swords. Only Stone soldier who speaks.

Name: LRD_GARMADON_S
Notes: Commands the Stone Army via the Helmet of Shadows.

Name: HRO_DARETH
Notes: The Brown Ninja. Genuinely canonically commands this army.

Name: HRO_SKYLOR
Notes: Master of Amber: copies the ability of whoever she last touched.

Name: HRO_RONIN
Notes: Mercenary. Available to the highest bidder.

Name: LRD_CRYPTOR
Notes: Modelled on Zane. Insufferable about it.

Name: LRD_CHEN
Notes: Cult leader. Runs a noodle empire as a front.

Name: LRD_MORRO
Notes: Wu's first student. Master of Wind. Possesses Lloyd.

Name: LRD_NADAKHAN
Notes: Djinn captain. Four arms. Grants wishes, badly.

Name: HRO_FLINTLOCKE
Notes: First mate. Two pistols, never misses.

Name: HRO_CYREN
Notes: Her singing voice stops an army.

Name: LRD_KRUX
Notes: Time Twin. Poses as Dr. Saunders.

Name: LRD_ACRONIX
Notes: Time Twin. The one who skipped 40 years.

Name: HRO_MACHIA
Notes: Actually competent. Replaces the other two.

Name: LRD_HARUMI
Notes: The Quiet One. Princess of Ninjago. The actual leader.

Name: HRO_KILLOW
Notes: Fist of the Quiet One. Enormous.

Name: HRO_MRE
Notes: Fist of the Quiet One. Nindroid.

Name: HRO_ULTRAVIOLET
Notes: Fist of the Quiet One. Manic.

Name: LRD_IRONBARON
Notes: Mechanical leg, claw arm, elaborate lie.

Name: LRD_OMEGA
Notes: Oni warlord supreme. Turns everything to dust.

Name: LRD_ASPHEERA
Notes: Stole Wu's Spinjitzu. Holds a 1000-year grudge.

Name: LRD_ICEEMPEROR
Notes: Zane, amnesiac, holding the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.

Name: HRO_GRIMFAX
Notes: Former Blizzard general and King of the Never-Realm. Defects.

Name: LRD_HARUMI_C
Notes: Field commander of the Crystal Army.

Name: LRD_BEATRIX
Notes: Usurper. Killed her father, imprisoned her sister.

Name: HRO_LAROW
Notes: Chief scientist. Built the MergeQuake weapon.

Name: LRD_BONEKING
Notes: Every enemy that dies near him joins him.
